headline: Onboarding and Implementation Consultant | Life Sciences SaaS | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health running client implementations across close to 200 practices. I own the project plan, coordinate clients with product and engineering, manage risks, and train users on launch. I also use AI tools daily and build simple AI workflows with n8n and Claude for my own product, Roovero.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery through configuration and go-live, keeping plans and dates on track.
Coordinated clients, clinicians and internal product teams through each rollout and handed clients over to ongoing support.
Trained 200+ end users on new workflows and features through demos and hands-on sessions.
Collected client feedback, grouped recurring issues into PRDs and feature requests, and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: project planning, governance and status meetings, risk and change tracking, client onboarding, launch coaching
demos, training, stakeholder communication, feedback sessions
Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, n8n workflows, React, GitHub
thesis_html: A customer launch works when people actually adopt it. I run it end to end.
why_fit: Plan, coordinate, launch and hand over.
PRDs that shipped from client feedback.
